publishedfiledetails.title: Wormholes and Sinkholes Icons For Server
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
I really liked the Wormhole Icons mod, but it was quite annoying to try to communicate with other persons if you wanted to talk about a specific wormhole. That's why I created this mod to combat this problem!

[h1]Overview[/h1]

This mod gives Wormhole Icons to every person on the server, but as it's a server mod, everyone has the same numbers!
This makes it much easier to communicate with each other!
I added an option to rename wormholes to what you want. You can choose in the mod options if everyone can change it or only admins. These changes will propagate to each person, so everybody will see your chosen name.
If you have "Wormhole Icons [Fixed]" activated, but don't want to deactivate it each time you want to use this mod, you can set their mod option "Wormhole marks disables" to Yes and the mod will be deactivated automatically.
This version also supports up to 300 wormholes, so no more crashes if you have more than 10.

Now the mod also gives Sinkholes icons and lets them be renamed. The Sinkholes will have the same color on the surface and the caves! They work the same as the wormhole icons, they can also be deactivated in the config options.

Happy Travelling!

[h1]Notes[/h1]
You can use [code]wis_reset_wormholes()[/code] to reset wormholes and [code]wis_reset_sinkholes()[/code] to reset sinholes.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1295277999]eXiGe and co.op for Wormhole Icons Fixed[/url]

publishedfiledetails.title: 花样风滚草 Interesting Tumbleweed
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
花样风滚草，也可以叫作“四次元风滚草”，为风滚草增加了更多的可能性。

推荐玩法：少资源模式，除了风滚草外，将其他资源均调成无，一切资源均靠风滚草，考验人品的时候到啦~

-----新增属性-----
幸运值：
1.每个人在加入世界时都会获得50点初始幸运值，幸运值将决定你从风滚草中开出好东西或者坏东西的概率。
2.幸运值的上限为100，下限为0。幸运值越高，开出好东西的几率越大；幸运值越低，开出怪物的几率越大。
3.默认情况下，每开一个风滚草，幸运值会下降一点，当然也可以通过mod设置界面设置游戏难度来控制下降点数，具体分级如下：
简单：开风滚草不降幸运值
普通(默认)：开风滚草扣除1点幸运值
稍难：开风滚草扣除2点幸运值
困难：开风滚草扣除5点幸运值
地狱：开风滚草扣除10点幸运值
4.幸运值可通过使用幸运道具来提升。

-----新增物品-----
符纸：用于制作各种符~
配方：木头*1+草*2（合成栏，二本）

红色羽毛笔：用来绘制转运符
配方：红雀羽毛*1+木炭*1+树枝*1（工具栏，二本）

蓝色羽毛笔：用来绘制保运符
配方：雪雀羽毛*1+木炭*1+树枝*1（工具栏，二本）

金色羽毛笔：用来绘制改命符
配方：金色羽毛*1+木炭*1+树枝*1（工具栏，二本）

祈运符：使用后增加15点幸运值，减少10精神值
配方：符纸*2+羽毛笔*1（需要在制图师桌子旁边制作，一次性制作两张）

转运符：使用后可将自己的幸运值变化为0~100的随机数，减少10点精神值
配方：符纸*1+红色羽毛笔*1（需要在制图师桌子旁边制作）

保运符：使用后幸运值重置到50，减少10点精神值
配方：符纸*1+蓝色羽毛笔*1（需要在制图师桌子旁边制作）

改命符：使用后增加(100-当前幸运值)点幸运值，并扣除与增加的幸运值等量的精神值
配方：符纸*1+金色羽毛笔*1（需要在制图师桌子旁边制作）

幸运宝石：合成幸运装备的材料
配方：幸运粉尘*5+紫色宝石*1（魔法一本，合成栏）

保运护符：佩戴时开风滚草不减少幸运值，耐久为100，可用幸运粉尘修复
配方：幸运宝石*1+噩梦燃料*3+金子*5（魔法二本，魔法栏）

幸运粉尘：合成幸运道具的基本材料，放在地面上会被风吹走
获得方式：开风滚草、燃烧各种符、幸运果汁过期产物、圣光祝福、幸运之星熄灭产物

幸运法杖：使用后可召唤出一颗幸运之星，消耗33精神，耐久为5次
配方：幸运宝石*1+噩梦燃料*3+活木*2（魔法二本，魔法栏）

幸运之星：会发光、冬暖夏凉，站在旁边会缓慢提升幸运值，拥有圣光祝福的能力，将幸运果实放上去会变成幸运粉尘，持续半天时间，熄灭后随机产生幸运道具

幸运帽：佩戴时+6幸运值/分钟、+6精神值/分钟，120秒保暖效果，耐久5天，可用幸运粉尘修复
配方：幸运宝石*1+海象帽*1+金子*5（蓝图解锁，服装栏）

幸运种子：4.7饥饿，保质期40天，可种出幸运果实，可从风滚草开出

幸运果实：9.4饥饿、-5精神、+5血量、+15幸运值，保质期10天，通过幸运之星的祝福会变成幸运粉尘

幸运果汁：+75饥饿、+15精神、+5血、+40幸运值，保质期2天，过期后会变成幸运粉尘
幸运果汁食谱：幸运果实*2+冰*1+蜂蜜*1

---新增事件---
1.**小海象有几率掉落幸运帽蓝图。
2.第一次开风滚草百分百开出：幸运护符*1+幸运宝石*1+祈运符*1

-----按钮介绍-----
资源再生：默认关闭，关闭时世界资源不再生，防止再生资源影响少资源世界的清静。
难度选择：默认为普通，可调整游戏难度，具体体现为开风滚草扣除的幸运值多少。游戏难度也会影响幸运道具的爆率。
基础资源：一些生存所需的基础资源。
高级资源：一些需要通过打怪、合成或其他方式得到的高级资源。
稀有资源：各种BOSS掉落物、宝石。
基础食物：浆果、胡萝卜、各种蘑菇、各种种子。
高级食物：各种水果、肉类。
普通料理：各种食谱料理。
大厨料理：用大厨锅做出来的各种料理。
风味料理：从风滚草中开出料理时有概率为其添加随机调料。
各种蓝图：各种东西的合成蓝图。
基础道具：一些最基础的道具、工具。
进阶道具：一些很有用的道具、工具。
稀有道具：一些很稀有的道具、工具。
基础装备：一些最基础的武器、衣物。
进阶装备：一些比较有用的武器、衣物。
稀有装备：一些非常稀有的武器、衣物。
普通怪物：一些比较普通的生物、怪物。
进阶怪物：一些稍稍厉害点的生物、怪物。
高级怪物：一些比较难打的怪物、BOSS。
花样作死：一些奇奇怪怪的作死内容。
特殊福利：一些小惊喜。

（ps：由于mod介绍字数有限，所以这里无法把Mod里的内容一一罗列出来，如果需要查看具体内容和更新日志的话，请移步到mod文件夹里找到一个叫作“resourceList”的资源列表查看哦~）


（pps：这是我17年做的Mod，在WeGame首发，一直没有上传到steam，后来我才发现有人未经过我允许盗传到了steam，叫作“多样风滚粗”，但是维护情况不好也没有仔细说明清楚这个Mod的功能，导致很多朋友没玩懂，所以我还是打算自己上传了。这个版本是我临时修复的版本，只对当前版本的游戏做了个简单的兼容，Mod介绍我也还没来得及认真编写。请喜欢这个Mod的朋友们给我一点时间，我会花一番功夫重新整改这个Mod，并制作一个像样的Mod介绍页给大家查看~~虽然不知道会拖到什么时候去，毕竟这是一个年更Mod，233333，发出了咕咕咕的声音。）

（ppps：另外再做个广告呀，大家可以去订阅一个叫作 能力勋章 的Mod呀~~是我今年新做的Mod~~~）


--------------2020/01/11更新------------------
1.加入了更多的新资源，如果还有什么落的地方欢迎给我留言；
2.取消了洞穴资源分类，全都归类到其他分类中了，并加入了大厨料理、风味料理按钮；
3.修复了关闭资源再生按钮失效的问题；
4.调整了幸运道具的配方以及功能，调整了风滚草内资源的开出概率，加强了幸运值的重要性；
5.重构了风滚草资源的调用方式，给风滚草内的资源留了API，允许其他Mod调用API加入更多的资源内容，包括Mod道具；如果有Moder需要的话可以查看modmain里的注释查看API调用方式；
6.增加了新组件防止玩家通过换人物刷保运护符。


[h1]Mod文档(Mod Document)[/h1]
由于篇幅有限，同时也为了维护方便，我为这个Mod制作了更加详细的Mod介绍页，需要查看Mod内道具介绍以及更新日志的小伙伴们可以访问下面的链接~

IJN Destroyer Inazuma, from Kantai Collection, or Kancolle.
(My mods are not skin compatible, aka they can't use alternate clothing besides gloves, pants/skirts, and shoes, because of the body proportions being different/taller from the default player proportions. It's not something I can fix.)

[Latest version: v1.2.6]
(Please update to the latest version before giving feedback, thank you!)

[Stats]
Health: 150
Hunger: 150
Sanity: 150 

[Traits/Perks]
Serious Side: Enters combat mode when struck by lightning. 
Truly an Angel: Gives sanity regen to nearby players. 
Reluctant Fighter: While not in combat mode, Inazuma deals 25% less damage, but has a 10% chance to dodge attacks.

[Serious Side]
When struck by lightning, Inazuma loses 50 sanity and transforms into her Plasma mode. In this mode, Inazuma moves faster, gains an extra 10% chance to dodge for a total of 20%, and both deal and receive 1.5x damage. Her sanity regen aura turns into a sanity drain aura, and she periodically loses sanity unless it's raining. Subsequent lightning strikes decrease her sanity by 20. When her sanity goes above 100, she turns back into normal.

Additionally, if she consumes an eggplant while in this state, she loses 20 sanity and returns to normal. In normal mode, she will lose 10 sanity instead.

Just like Hibiki, all her perks are toggleable in the configurations.

My second Kancolle mod, the cute and clumsy fourth ship of the Akatsuki-class Destroyers, Inazuma. Trying to upload this was a nightmare because the uploader was broken for some reason. I'll eventually do the rest of the Sixth Destroyer Division, but for now I'm probably gonna polish these two.

Converts Fuel into Ice!

The Ice Maker is a Science structure that can be built in the Shipwrecked DLC. It runs on fuel items. When fueled, it produces one Ice every 30 seconds. If the machine runs out of fuel before 30 seconds have passed since the last Ice was produced, it will shut down and stop producing more until it is refueled, wasting any remaining fuel in the process. It can hold up to 90 seconds of fuel, and each fuel item added increases its duration according to its burn time in a Campfire.

Players cannot turn off the machine while it is running. When examined, some characters have different quotes depending on how much fuel remains in the machine; this is the only way to check its fuel level.

  1x Thermal Stone
  5x Logs
  2x Electrical Doodad
  > Alchemy Engine

Note: The crafting recipe requires the Alchemy Engine (tier 2). You need to be at least next to a Science Machine for it to appear in the crafting menu.

publishedfiledetails.title: Gollum DST
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1]Mod adds playable Gollum and his One Ring! Inspired by LOTR.[/h1]


Here you can find [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=312790426]Gollum[/url] for DS :) 

[h1]HISTORY AND DESCRIPTION[/h1]
This character is inspired by Gollum from JRR Tolkien's universe. For this mod we have imagined that this is Gollum long before he ever met Bilbo and Frodo. Gollum will not speak of hobbits. Instead, you will see Gollum make various references to the creatures from Tolkien's books, such as goblins, orcs, trolls, and Ents.

Gollum begins the game with the "mystery ring", which is his special indestructible item, and also with 4 raw fish. When the game starts there is a custom introduction where you find that Maxwell wants The Ring for himself. Even worse, he wants to take the ring from Gollum's corpse!


[h1]STATS[/h1]
Hunger: 140
Health: 140
Sanity: 160

speed: +30%
damage: - 25%
hunger drop: -20%
Sanity drain in night: -50%


[h1]PERKS[/h1]
Slave of the Ring - Gollum is so attached to the ring that he doesn't ever want to lose sight of it. He can't put the ring down on the ground, nor put it in a chest or backpack. Only death can deprive him of the ring. If Gollum resurrects after death, he will have a sanity penalty until he finds the ring again.

Loves Meat - Gollum loves meat, especially raw. Also he eats monster meat with no penalty. During the decades spent underground, he would eat any kind of meat he could manage to score. Meat provides a different bonus for Gollum than the rest of the characters from the Don't Starve:
*Raw meat: +(5 to 10) sanity
*Cooked meat: no gain or loss to sanity
*Monster Meat: No penalty to sanity

Passionate About Fish - Gollum's favorite food is fish, both fresh and cooked. Gollum became incredibly skilled at fishing with his bare hands during his hundreds of years spent underground. He can't use fishing rods, but with his bare hands he can catch 1 fish PER POND every 3 DAYS. Additionally, Gollum receives a higher premium for eating fish than the other characters:
*Raw fish: 37.5 hunger, +21 health and +20 sanity

Fruits and Vegetables? Bleh! - On the road to becoming a wild creature, overwhelmed by darkness, Gollum lost his taste for eating fruits and vegetables; he can only be satisfied by meat. Eating fruits and vegetables results in a penalty to sanity:
*Fruits and vegetables: -20 sanity

Clamped Stomach - spending years in the depths of the earth, Gollum got used to going longer periods of time without food. Gollum's Hunger drops about 20% slower.

Faster! - Gollum learned to move very quickly to get what he needed and stay out of trouble. Gollum's movement speed is 30% higher.

Weak - Burdened by the dark power of the Ring for so many years, Gollum lost his strength and became more and more limited. Gollum deals 25% less damage in combat.

The Night Creature - Gollum is accustomed to darkness and the night, and feels much less discomfort after sunset.
His sanity penalty during dusk and nighttime is half that of other characters.


[h1]THE RING[/h1]
+ Gollum becomes invisible to creatures (as long as they were not in conflict with him before he used the ring.) This helps Gollum to avoid strong opponents and many dangers. There are only two conditions, when he CAN be attacked after using the ring- Gollum can be killed by Grue and the ring will not hide him from periodically attacking hounds. If you want to hide from the hounds, you must lose them after they arrive.

+ While using the ring, Gollum can steal items in dangerous spots without alerting nearby monsters.

- While using the Ring, Gollum can't attack animals or monsters. (Gollum is worried that someone might notice him and steal the ring.) This is necessary to balance the invisible feature of the ring, otherwise the player could exploit the ability and become unattackable during normal combat (and would basically become invincible).

- When Gollum uses the ring, it's power will drive him to madness. During use, Gollum automatically begins to see hallucinations and nightmares. Furthermore he loses 2 sanity per second, making this item both useful and dangerous for Gollum.

- While in the grip of the ring's special power, a screen filter appears, which significantly narrows the field of vision and makes moving around the world more difficult, especially at night.

! When Gollum dies, he drops the ring on the ground. When Gollum is revived, he gets a sanity drop until he regains the ring. He can also lose the ring by fighting a Bearger, MooseGoose, or frogs.


[h1]OTHER FEATURES[/h1]
*Custom sounds - Gollum has a set of unique sounds, which (according to legend) are based on the sound of a cello at a low octave.
*All custom lines - over 1100 custom quotes including DLC lines.
*Map icon for Gollum and for the Ring
*Portrait and a full set of images in the menu
*Few mod configuration options


[h1][b]BUGS?[/b][/h1]
Did you encountered a bug, crash or glitch? If you want to make sure that we can fix it, please report it in comments with your log file (C:/users/documents/Klei/DoNotStarve/log) attached (pastebin for example).


[h1]ENJOY :][/h1]
This mod was made by three people:
Mr. Hastings (DS version: art, sounds, quotes, testing)
Star (Whole programming for DST version)
Kuloslav (DS version programming, suggestions in DST)

Weapon growth:
Initial durability is 5, hitting mobs or objects that have a healthbar will inrease durability (weapon's durability is equivalent to its level).
Higher the durability, higher the damage over time, and faster the attack speed.
To max durability: hit 2000 times.
